description: This file contains Go test code for Android Cuttlefish's power button functionality, including tests that interact with device power state and container setup.

methods.name: TestPowerBtn
methods.description: Test that the power button toggles the screen from ON to OFF on the device.

methods.name: TestPowerBtnNoHostTool
methods.description: Test the power button functionality when the host tool is missing; verifies toggling screen state.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Helper to set up a device for testing by uploading images and creating a CVD instance.

methods.name: readScreenStateLine
methods.description: Reads the device's display state by executing dumpsys via ADB.
